name: Hang-Time HAR
description: A benchmark dataset for recognizing basketball activities from wrist-worn inertial sensors (IMU) captured during play.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific wearable-sensor HAR dataset used in HCI and sports-analytics research but not a broadly adopted community standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; likely small/controlled participant pool, sensor-placement bias (wrist-only), class imbalance and potential overfitting risks; careful cross-subject evaluation recommended.
